title: Concept: Archive extraction via zip.extractAll (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, zip.extractAll writes archive members to the filesystem. Entry names are attacker-controlled metadata in hostile archives, so extraction without name checks is a write primitive. The remedy is per-entry validation via entry-name validation before write.
applicability: javascript codebases extracting archives through zip.extractAll; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file overwrite (Zip Slip) from hostile archives; HIGH severity because archives routinely cross trust boundaries.
